normal.text: STAR OF PROVIDENCE IS AMAZING! one of the best games i ever discovered!!! i remember this old pc game i played as a baby called Wacky Wheels, it was a mario kart clone on PC with animal people. it had a demo mode with locked characters but i figured out an exploit that let me play as anyone :D

normal.name: Arionis Chambers
normal.text: "Mega Man Legends could finally be getting a sequel! Aren't you excited?" 1. It already had one, yes I will be pedantic over this. 2. The last time a game from my childhood *finally* got a sequel, it was cancelled so some other bastardization could have it's name instead. RIP, Bloodlines 2....

normal.name: Erik Kelly
normal.text: A great example of SEGA's "loud" mid-90s advertising aesthetic here, but most striking is the cost of all this. Everything mentioned here? A Genesis ($149) + Sega CD ($299) + Sega 32X ($159) = $607. In today's dollars that's $1380! For games that were (Genesis aside) not all that good, honestly.
